name: home-family
description: Household admin for Thai families — reading electricity (MEA/PEA, Ft) and water bills with a monthly tracker, a seasonal home-maintenance schedule for the Thai climate, vehicle tax, compulsory insurance and inspection reminders, weekly meal plans with grocery lists, school terms and enrolment documents, elder-care rights and medication tables, and pet vaccination records. General information only, not legal, tax or medical advice.
